title: Anthropic Staff Openly Talk About ‘Taking Over the World’, Claims Max Tegmark
lede: Novara Media reports MIT physicist Max Tegmark's claim that Anthropic employees, after a few drinks, talk about overthrowing the US government under the label 'alignment without control'.

points: Tegmark says the phrase means governing AI through instilled values, likely Anthropic's own, instead of direct human control.
He says OpenAI and Anthropic lobby against oversight and are less regulated in the US than a sandwich shop.
Novara says it asked Anthropic for comment; none is reported.
The claim lands amid protests at Nasdaq and Anthropic's San Francisco office, and a London march of over 1,000 people.

points.text: A commenter posts the transcript; a reply calls it a game of telephone, an unnamed person's tipsy remark relayed secondhand.
Commenters split on whether the headline misleads; a reply links the video timestamp and says the quote is accurate in context.
Several read it as ordinary growth-company talk, though one reply argues Tegmark meant something different from market dominance.
Others doubt any physical takeover, noting Anthropic lacks robotics and supply chains and does not own its data centers.
